thread:
incident-bot: PD ALERT: GPU memory pressure in pool infer-us-west2a (node gpu-78). nvml reports growing memory_used and OOM kernel messages. paging infra-sre
PagerDuty: Incident INC-3422 routed to kevin_oncall
kevin_oncall: acked — taking lead, switching to #incident-3422. starting triage
alex_sre: kvcache prefetch spike at 03:12:07 UTC, signs of fragmentation + alloc failures
jen_runtime: runtime logs show repeated cudaErrorMemoryAllocation and prefetch failures:
```
[03:12:06] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[03:12:07] kvcache: prefetch 48MB failed
```
jen_runtime: marking node draining, shifting new low-priority inference off gpu-78
kevin_oncall: enabling fallback routing for non-critical traffic; keeping premium routes pinned to reserve nodes
maria_pm: any customer-facing errors yet? CS flagged slow responses
kevin_oncall: brief error spike for alpha-inc and beta-co ~3.5% — not a full outage, but visible latency degradation
alex_sre: pushing an eviction tweak and reducing kvcache_prefetch_window via runtime feature-flag
jen_runtime: applied flag, restarted runtime agent on gpu-78 — mem footprint dropped ~22% within a minute
incident-bot: autoscaler: provisioning replacement node gpu-91, expected ready in ~90s
kevin_oncall: new node joined, caches warmed, shifting traffic back. error rate stabilized to ~0.3%
alex_sre: collecting heap profiles and nvml traces, filing follow-up: INC-3422-RCA
maria_pm: drafting customer comms: "Transient memory pressure affected a subset of inference requests; mitigation is underway."
jen_runtime: will reproduce in staging with aggressive prefetch + fragmentation. provisional mitigation: default prefetch 128->64MB and add mem-usage circuit-breaker
kevin_oncall: handing to morning rotation at 07:00 UTC — monitor for 15m then mark resolved
kevin_oncall: marking incident mitigated in PagerDuty after 15m stable. follow-ups: postmortem, runtime change, alert tuning
incident-bot: Incident mitigated; automated follow-up reminders scheduled for 24h and 72h
alex_sre: will own postmortem and link telemetry, assign to eng-runtime
maria_pm: thanks team, CS notified affected customers and provided ETA for permanent fix
